newsitem.title: USA: Pease Oil sets Bayou Sorrel acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Pease Oil sets Bayou Sorrel acquisition.

text.p: Pease Oil and Gas Co said Monday it signed a letter of intent to acquire a 7.8125 percent after payout working interest in the East Bayou Sorrel Prospect in Louisiana's Iberville Parish from third parties for an undisclosed amount of common stock and cash.
The transaction is scheduled to close in late December, Pease said.
The field is operated by National Energy Group Inc.

"This acquisition is representative of Pease's enthusiasm surrounding its decision to participate in eight to 10 projects with NEGX over the next 12-18 months and represents a port of entry for Pease into this area," the company said.
